description: Authoritative Wave-1 batch-C boundary ownership. Stable-code edges and undeclared exact source literals are reverse-discovered from code-registry.json; the signatures below cover bounded correctness fixes and display-only census rows that do not yet have stable codes. Generic same-word literals outside a protocol require an exact code/path/count/reason classification. Rows classify discoveries, never waive them. Implemented catalog boundaries name their G2 owner and verification suite separately from the original Wave-1 blockers; they do not certify native, translation, or performance acceptance.
